text:
Sara (support): customer reported intermittent errors on /v1/embeddings: "dimension mismatch" and occasional 500s + big tail lat. Happened after we changed default max_batch_size to 64 last week.
Kevin (runtime): ugh. can you paste a sample request/response? is it always the same client? any pattern on payload sizes?
Sara (support): attaching a redacted log: `ERROR EmbeddingService: dims 0 != 1536` — client says they send arrays of varying length, some 1536, some 1535. They also report long latencies ~1.8s p95 when normally ~120ms.
Lee (eng-ml): if they're sending mixed dims in a single request set, dynamic batching could mix them into the same batch -> dim check fails. we should reject mixed-dim payloads earlier or make batch split by dim.
Kevin (runtime): Agreed. Our dynbatch groups by model but not by vector length. We recently swapped to a cheaper hash-based bucketer to reduce mem usage; that change may allow mixing dims across shards.
Kevin (runtime): Quick repro: `python -c "import requests; requests.post("$URL", json={'inputs': [[0.1]*1536, [0.1]*1535]})"` -> will trigger the mismatch.
Sara (support): customer says their SDK does async chunking; sometimes floats become strings due to serialization bug. also saw `null` embedding in one payload.
Lee (eng-ml): serialization issues could produce shorter arrays. Can you ask for raw payload or a base64 dump? meanwhile i'll check traces for batching coalescing.
infra-bot: deploy started by @kevin at 2412345700 - runtime bucketer rollback queued :hammer_and_wrench:
Kevin (runtime): Rolled back the bucketer at 2412345720 to the per-request sharding. Please monitor p95.
Lee (eng-ml): looking at traces — when dynbatch is on, coalesce_window_ms=20 causes more waiting; for small high-QPS clients that increases p95. Also saw one shard with 90% of embed work causing queueing.
Kevin (runtime): two knobs to tune: lower coalesce_window_ms to 5ms for low-latency plans; or set max_batch_size=32 for that route. Larger max_batch_size increases throughput but can worsen tail for mixed-size requests.
Sara (support): sent customer a request: 1) add client-side validation to ensure consistent dim, 2) enable retry/backoff for 500s, 3) switch to our newer SDK 1.4.2 which avoids stringifying floats.
Lee (eng-ml): added a quick guard in the runtime: reject batch if any payload dims differ, emit metric `batch.dim_mismatch` (will be in next rollout). also flagged route `embed-v1` for per-tenant max_batch_size override.
Kevin (runtime): for immediate mitigation I patched the routing table to set max_batch_size=32 for the customer's tenant and disabled dynbatch coalescing for that route.
Sara (support): customer confirmed noticeably lower p95 in first 10m after patch. still reported a single 500 - checking logs now.
Sara (support): action items: @Lee to add batch-dim grouping in bucketer (ETA 2d), @Kevin to add config to allow per-tenant coalesce_window and max_batch override (ETA today), @Sara to follow up with customer and confirm SDK update.
Lee (eng-ml): I'll do the grouping change and add unit tests to catch mixed-dim merges. will open PR 3956.
Kevin (runtime): I'll add the per-tenant override to the console API, will also emit an alert if `batch.dim_mismatch` > 0.
Sara (support): thanks team :thumbsup: marking this thread resolved for now; will reopen if customer sees regressions.
